sections.title: 12 new languages
items: Mealie Recipes now speaks Italian, Russian, Swedish, Danish, Czech, Finnish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) – pick your language in the settings.
The new languages use Mealie's own terms wherever Mealie translates them, so the app matches the web app.
Widgets, watch apps and the shopping reminder speak the new languages too.
Cooking mode now recognizes times in steps in all app languages and suggests timers for them, and the meal plan dice recognizes meal categories in the new languages.

sections.title: Unit conversion
items: Convert ingredient units like in the Mealie web app: show recipes as written, in metric (g, ml) or imperial (cups, oz) – choose under ⋮ → Units. Works in the recipe view, cooking mode and PDF export; the recipe itself stays unchanged.

sections.title: Ready for Mealie 3.31
items: Export a whole cookbook as a PDF with cover page and table of contents – tap the PDF button in a cookbook (requires Mealie 3.31).
Cookbook descriptions now show Markdown formatting such as bold text, lists and links.
Recipe actions support the new temporary share link placeholder, so other services can open private recipes too.

sections.title: More filters
items: Cookbooks and meal plan rules can now also filter by label, rating, last made, date created and date updated.
The recipe finder can filter by date created and date updated.

sections.title: Ingredient substitutions
items: Ingredients with substitutions now show a ⇄ button in the recipe view and cooking mode – tap it to see the alternatives from the recipe and the food's common substitutes, just like in Mealie's web app.
Recipe PDFs list the substitutions below each ingredient.

sections.title: API tokens
items: Manage your Mealie API tokens from the account menu: create tokens for other apps (e.g. Home Assistant), copy them once and delete them again – available with “advanced features” enabled in Mealie, just like in the web app.

sections.title: Meal plan notes
items: Long notes in the meal plan are limited to 3 lines – tap "Show more…" to expand the full note and "Show less" to collapse it again.
Meal plan notes now show Markdown formatting such as bold text, lists and links, just like in Mealie's web app.

sections.title: Shopping list like Mealie
items: Items are now sorted like in Mealie's web app: in the order they were added, with matching items grouped together, and the most recently checked items at the top of the completed section.
New items from the app now appear at the end of the list in Mealie's web app instead of at the top.

sections.title: Fixes
items: The cook time is shown in the recipe list again.
A clear message appears when a file is too large for the server's upload limit.
Items deleted in the web app or on another device now disappear from the shopping list right away instead of staying until a manual refresh.
When Mealie merges two identical items (e.g. after unchecking one), the list now shows only the merged item instead of a duplicate line.
Editing a recipe note in the recipe view or cooking mode no longer breaks the links between steps and notes in Mealie.
Changing the AI provider no longer resets other AI settings on newer Mealie versions.
